entities.summary: Mongkut, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Thonburi and Early Rattanakosin (1851–1868). Preceded by Bowring Treaty and Chakri. Their legacy influenced Bowring Treaty with Britain opens Siam to free trade and Western commerce.
